finding_summary: No P0, P1, P2, or P3 findings.

contract_and_static_audit.authorization: Every request is bounds-checked before array indexing, then requires bank_busy and exact owner-role equality.
contract_and_static_audit.denied_access: No bank_ena or bank_enb assertion occurs unless the corresponding valid-and-ready handshake succeeds.
contract_and_static_audit.collision_policy: Same-bank MM2S/PSUM writes suppress both; any same-bank pair among S2MM, ACT, WGT, and PSUM reads suppresses every colliding reader; nonconflicting banks can proceed concurrently.
contract_and_static_audit.psum_dual_port: Concurrent PSUM read and write to the same bank is intentionally accepted on separate native A/B ports.
contract_and_static_audit.sticky_fault: The first fault is retained until reset. Combinational priority is owner 1, owner 2, owner 3, owner 4, then owner 5 write before owner 5 read.
contract_and_static_audit.parameter_legality: BANK_NUM, BANK_NUM_WIDTH, PORT_ROLE_WIDTH, READ_LATENCY, address/data/byte widths, divisibility, nonzero role IDs, and pairwise-distinct role IDs are guarded; the default configuration is legal.
contract_and_static_audit.read_latency_pipeline: Each accepted read shifts valid and bank identity through exactly READ_LATENCY stages; response data is selected with the delayed bank tag. Reset flushes every valid/tag pipeline and sticky fault metadata.
contract_and_static_audit.dependency_instantiation: No bank_ownership_table, bram_bank, or uram_bank instance is present; these are frozen interface/dependency identities, not integration evidence.

coverage: S2MM response at READ_LATENCY=3 with no early valid
same-bank PSUM read/write on separate ports
three distinct-bank ports and overlapping-read collision suppression
write and read collisions with no physical enable
reset flush during active response pipeline and sticky fault
first-fault owner priority and owner-5 write-before-read priority
base_self_checking_simulation.assertion_depth: The testbench checks ready, physical enables, addresses, write data/strobes, exact response-valid cycles, destination bank tags/data, early-response absence, consecutive overlap, fault metadata, and reset flushing.

independent_latency_probe.purpose: Independent off-by-one and destination-routing check at READ_LATENCY=3.
independent_latency_probe.coverage: Two consecutive cycles each issue simultaneous ACT/WGT reads to four distinct banks. The probe rejects early responses, checks the first pair exactly three cycles later, checks the second pair on the following cycle, and checks valid deassertion afterward.
independent_latency_probe.pass_marker: PASS: independent latency3 consecutive ACT/WGT probe
independent_latency_probe.verifier_harness_diagnostics: Two earlier xvlog attempts were preserved after syntax defects in the temporary verifier-only testbench. The corrected third compile/elaboration/simulation passed; the earlier diagnostics do not identify DUT failures.

verilator.warnings: Nine LITENDIAN warnings arise from the contract-required ascending [0:BANK_NUM-1] bank arrays; no functional lint warning or error was reported.

vivado_ooc.timing_exceptions: Hold-only false paths cover unplaced external data input/output ports. Internal register-to-register hold remains timed; the reported worst hold path is act_bank_pipe_r_reg[0][0]/Q to act_bank_pipe_r_reg[1][0]/D.
vivado_ooc.warnings: The flattened large primitive netlist warning, empty blackbox query warning, and OOC connectivity-coverage warnings are consistent with an unplaced standalone module and do not support board-level claims.

scope_and_limitations.validated: Reusable bank-port routing/control RTL with default parameters, contract identities, static safety properties, functional simulation, lint, and 200 MHz post-synthesis OOC timing.
residual_risks: The actual bank_ownership_table and BRAM/URAM storage modules are not instantiated, so integrated ownership behavior, physical memory latency, read-during-write mode, and final data alignment remain unverified.
The 7053-LUT wide combinational routing cost must be remeasured after hierarchy integration, placement, and routing.
OOC external-port hold paths are intentionally excluded because ports are unplaced; only internal register-to-register hold timing is meaningful here.
Nondefault parameter combinations were guarded and statically audited but were not exhaustively simulated or synthesized.
